destination.name: Kuranda
destination.tagline: A rainforest village in the hills above Cairns, reached by train or Skyrail
destination.description: Kuranda is a small village beside Barron Gorge National Park, about 40 minutes by road from Cairns. Most visitors arrive by the Kuranda Scenic Railway, which climbs 329 m over 34 km, or by the Skyrail gondola over the rainforest canopy. In the village are its markets and wildlife attractions, including Birdworld, a butterfly sanctuary and Koala Gardens, and Barron Falls can be seen from the railway platform.
whyVisit: Ride the train or Skyrail up

goodToKnow.title: Go up one way, back the other
goodToKnow.detail: Many visitors take the Scenic Railway up in the morning and the Skyrail down, or the reverse. Carriages are not air-conditioned and booking is recommended.

goodToKnow.title: Midday crowds
goodToKnow.detail: The village and markets are packed in the middle of the day with visitors. Arrive early for quieter streets.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} is the dry season, easier for the village and gorge walks. Barron Falls is only a trickle then.
